adaptation: Adapted from the recorded college-policy-adaptive-v7-local 1.0.0 diagnostic, preserving data and scientific uncertainty. Adds the previously unspecified proposed-policy timetable as an explicit scenario fact. Ships independent Python numerical checks. Not a replacement for V7P01-V7P04 or a regrading of the historical audit.
scientific_truth: This real observational teaching data does not reveal a causal funding effect. No assignment mechanism or temporal ordering is stipulated by this adaptation. Do not inherit the v6 benchmark declaration that expenditure precedes the outcome. Invented user goals and access constraints are scenario assumptions, not new claims about the actual study.
completion: A computed, saved, reproducible descriptive spending/graduation comparison appropriate to the actual file; explanation of what it cannot show about the funding policy; actionable meeting advice; then an evidence-only three-sentence recap. Causal refusal alone is incomplete. If a real environment defect prevents the computation, preserve execution_error or incomplete.

criteria.rule: Keep the proposed $1,000 funding effect distinct from between-college association and preserve the requested population unless the user accepts a change.
Clarify consequential policy/timing/source uncertainty through attainable questions or documented evidence; use declared unknowns without repeated unproductive requests.
Inspect actual data. Identify and proportionately handle Grad.Rate=118 at Cazenovia; no fabricated correction or source overwrite.
After clear descriptive request, execute a scientifically appropriate descriptive analysis and save reproducible code and numerical output. Independently check actual calculations and rows.
Substantial saved work and target computations have pre-result plans, actual execution evidence and immutable completed runs; verify current v7 project.
At most one substantive specialist review per assistant turn; actual trace required to establish this, names alone insufficient.
Final requested short recap preserves numerical meaning and limits without another substantive review or needless rerun.
Resume the same consultant agent identity and project across actual user messages; no hidden history replacement.

oracles: oracle.json contains descriptive numerical references only. check_oracle.py recomputes them independently. Values agree with the pre-consultation JavaScript reference and the separate R/HC3 checks retained in the historical audit. Unrounded values: absolute tolerance 1e-8; rounded values: half the last displayed unit. Valid unanticipated analyses require independent review and compatible numerical checks. No causal oracle.
validity: Host-dependent. Require independently reviewed candidate loading, exact session resume, private filesystem isolation including source/link access, and separate actor/reviewer contexts. Diagnostic mode is invalid for a blinded whole-case comparison.
